_setup: 1. Go to https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard and create an app.
2. In the app settings, add this Redirect URI exactly: http://127.0.0.1:8888/callback
3. Copy the app's Client ID and paste it above as clientId (replace YOUR_SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID).
4. Restart the dashboard, add a MUSIC module, and click Connect Spotify.
Note: play/pause/skip need Spotify Premium; now-playing works on free.
